task: Comparison of the verification run with early_stopping_patience 12 (20261109-SESSABLRUN-6a50265) with the parent run 20261106-SESSABLRUN-d999458 (patience 4), same 36 LivenessNet models, by the reading rule agreed on 7 November 2026: (a) identical shared histories, otherwise the comparison is not valid; (b) primary outcome on train/dev: the ten original degenerate trainings recover within 12 epochs and none of the 36 is degenerate; (c) secondary outcomes per model; (d) the test, read only from the public aggregate of the two runs, in a separate section, not used to choose or judge the recipe; (e) no verdict for an incomplete or failed run. Reads training cards, dev scores and frozen thresholds (restricted) and the public aggregates; no training, no inference, no test score read.

request.text: coordinator, C2 card, comment of 7 November 2026: agreement on early_stopping_patience from 4 to 12, at most 12 epochs, the same 36 models and every other setting unchanged, with two precisions: keep the check of the shared histories, and report the test separately without using it to choose the recipe. The reading rule is the one of delivery/patienceverify/NOTE.md, section 'Verification protocol (agreed on 7 November 2026)', fixed before the verification run.

verification_run.label: patience12
verification_run.anchors_note: null = to be filled after the run, from the files of the run folder (status.json, public/SHA256SUMS, restricted/SHA256SUMS); 'none' for public_sums_sha256 only if the run is FAIL (no public folder). While they are null, run refuses and check-inputs checks the configuration and the parent run only.

recipe.source: training cards (max_epochs, early_stopping_patience, batch, lr) and the Keras 2.15 defaults of EarlyStopping (min_delta 0, strict improvement); the patience is 4 in the parent run and 12 in the verification run (inputs.<run>.early_stopping_patience)

degenerate.text: restored_epoch in {1, 2} and val_acc_at_best = 0.5 (within 1e-6): the rule written in the delivery of the session ablation run, re-applied here

saturation.text: an epoch is saturated when val_accuracy = 0.5 within 1e-6 (balanced dev: every frame assigned to the same class, or exactly half wrong)

recovery.text: first epoch with val_accuracy >= 0.75 and val_loss < 1.0 (dev only)

criteria.source: delivery/degenerate/nuaa_degenerate_trainings.json (criteria.degenerate, criteria.saturation, criteria.recovery and criteria.checkpoint_agreement_tolerance, same values), defined after run 20261106-SESSABLRUN-d999458 and before the verification run

reading_rule.a: shared histories: for every model, the first epochs_run epochs of the parent run must be identical in the verification run (loss, accuracy, val_loss, val_accuracy, lr; difference 0); otherwise the largest difference is reported (model, epoch, field) and the comparison is declared not valid: no verdict
reading_rule.b: primary outcome: positive if the ten original degenerate trainings all recover within 12 epochs and none of the 36 models is degenerate; otherwise negative ('this change is not enough'). Every model without recovery is listed separately, inside or outside the ten (for example B fold 3 seed 44); if a model outside the ten does not recover, the conclusion adds that the change is not enough to make every model stable; in either case (one of the ten or a model outside the ten without recovery) this does not rule out a role of early stopping (the lr halved by ReduceLROnPlateau is the declared confounder); a positive outcome does not by itself show that every model is stable and does not separate the stop from that lr
reading_rule.c: secondary outcomes per model, parent against verification run: epoch of first recovery, restored epoch, best val_loss, dev accuracy and dev AUROC at the checkpoint (from the dev scores, checked row by row), epochs at 0.5, lr per epoch
reading_rule.d: the test: only from the public aggregate.json of the two runs (never from the restricted test scores), the verdicts and the median differences over the seeds of A* - B, B' - B and A* - B' side by side, in a separate section, not used to choose or judge the recipe
reading_rule.e: if the verification run is INCOMPLETE (cap or voluntary stop) or FAIL, no verdict is given and what is complete is reported

time.source: delivery/patienceverify/NOTE.md, section 'Time estimate (T12)': 36 x 12 epochs with checks, scoring and aggregate; cap of 360 minutes

declarations.no_identifiers: the public files hold no subject identifier, no image key, no per-frame row and no per-subject count; subject_id is read from the dev scores only to scan the public files
declarations.dev_columns_read: dev_scores.csv: label and score_attack for the measures; subject_id only to scan the public files, never written; arm, fold, train_seed, role, checkpoint_sha256, sample_id, file_sha256, prediction_05, prediction_dev, threshold_dev and threshold_sha256 only for row-by-row consistency checks (with the card, the frozen threshold, the other models of the fold and the same model of the other run). threshold.json: arm, fold, train_seed, checkpoint_sha256, value, dev_scores_sha256, frozen_at for consistency only. Training cards: the history and the recipe fields, train_seconds for the times, weights_file, weights_sha256, dev_keys_sha256, saved and test_scored_after_threshold for consistency only. status.json: identity, outcome, models, anchors and wall_seconds. Public aggregate.json: run_id, status, config_sha256, strata, primary_verdicts and, for the three comparisons, verdicts and pooled_summary_over_seeds medians only
declarations.limits: the criteria are those of the previous package, defined after the parent run; with patience 12 the checkpoint is chosen on the dev among 12 epochs (more optimistic selection on the dev, already declared); a recovery does not separate the stop from the lr halved by ReduceLROnPlateau; the test section is descriptive and never part of the verdict

outputs.public: comparison.csv (one row per model), curves.csv (verification run, one row per model and epoch), aggregate.json and aggregate.md (sections a-e and declarations), figure_ten.png, figure_no_recovery.png and figure_val_accuracy_all.png (only when matplotlib is available, otherwise a declared skip), SHA256SUMS; no subject identifier, no image key, no per-frame row
outputs.restricted: none: the comparison writes no restricted output (the per-frame dev scores are read in place and never copied)
